description: Hand poses that must not engage a fist, as segments separated by a frame with no hands: hand curling as it drops (0.0-1.1 s); relaxed, loosely curled hand (1.6-21.1 s); two-hand pinches with the other fingers curled (21.6-30.1 s); finger gun, held and turned (30.6-45.3 s); finger gun variations (45.8-52.1 s). The two-hand pinches should engage as pinches (once per hand). The relaxed hand's fingertips come as close to the wrist as a fist's (reach 0.9-1.5), but its fingers stay straighter (0.70-0.81). The dropping hand reads as a fist for 100 ms. Recorded from a live webcam at 320x240 via HandwaveWidget.hands_data (every other frame, ~27 fps); labels are as the tracker sees them.
